scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter frontend test && pnpm --filter backend test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter frontend test:coverage && pnpm --filter backend test:coverage
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter backend lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter shared typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter backend typecheck
